## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly car racing game in the existing project.

- Home screen with Play and Store accessible at the screen edge.

- Play offers quick race, online race, and duel modes.
- World map progression unlocks routes and cars; rarity tiers are Rare < Epic < Mythical < Legendary < Chromatic.
- Duel mode records a race/ghost; rivals should attempt overtakes.
- Race solo or against bots, use selected or random tracks/events, and support online-race flow.
- Include a 30-second pass-the-Bimba event.
- 3D-game presentation and phone/tablet touch support.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-rendered race visuals, no external game engine.
- Online mode is represented as a simulated lobby; saved race ghost data is local.
- Browser localStorage is used for player progress and currency.
- Default tracks, car lineup, prices, race controls, rewards, and progression were chosen without clarification.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly car racing game in the existing project, including races, progression, a store, rewards, and a timed Pass the Bimba event.

## Requirements
- Home screen with Play and Store accessible at the screen edge; store sells cars, driver outfits, and car wraps for in-game credits.
- Credits come from race wins, daily logins, and daily tasks; Play offers quick race, online race, and duel modes.
- World progression unlocks routes and cars across Rare < Epic < Mythical < Legendary < Chromatic tiers.
- Rivals attempt overtakes; duel mode records a race/ghost. Support solo or bot races, selected or random tracks/events, and online-race flow.
- Include a 30-second Pass the Bimba event; support phone/tablet touch controls and a 3D-game presentation.

## Decisions
- Implemented as standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with canvas-rendered pseudo-3D visuals and no external game engine.
- Online mode is a simulated lobby; progress and ghost data are stored locally in `localStorage`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game screens, setup modal, race HUD, touch controls, responsive styling, save state, store purchases, navigation, daily claim, world/reward rendering, race loop, rivals, and canvas scene.
- Added world progression on wins and fixed `keyup` handler cleanup between races.
- Added local-date task reset scaffolding and `dateKey()`.

### Active
- Validate runtime and gameplay in a browser; address bugs and inspect a current screenshot.
- Finish daily/task reward behavior and review race/event flow.

### Blocked
- Browser validation is blocked because `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with `Browser "chromium" is not installed`; system Chromium is present at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and resolve any syntax/runtime issues from the latest edits.
2. Complete task claims/reward logic and review daily reward UI/state.
3. Validate navigation, purchases, modes, controls, rewards, progression, and event flow in a browser; capture and inspect a current screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: game state, race mechanics, rendering, rewards.
- `index.html`: game UI and screen markup.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and game UI styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` currently adds task reset state (`taskClaims`, `taskDate`), but task claiming/reward logic remains incomplete; the weekly reward display references `claimedDays`, which is not yet wired to claim behavior.
- `startRace` now stores both keyboard handlers; `stopRace` removes them and clears the references.
- The development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile-friendly racing game in the existing project, including progression, a store, rewards, and a timed Pass the Bimba event.

## Requirements
- Home screen with Play and Store accessible at the screen edge; store sells cars, driver outfits, and wraps for in-game credits.
- Credits from race wins, daily logins, and daily tasks; Play offers quick race, online race, and duel modes.
- World progression unlocks routes and cars across Rare < Epic < Mythical < Legendary < Chromatic tiers.
- Rivals attempt overtakes; duel mode records a race/ghost. Support solo or bot races, selected or random tracks/events, and online-race flow.
- Include a 30-second Pass the Bimba event; support phone/tablet touch controls and a 3D-game presentation.

## Decisions
- Implemented as standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with canvas-rendered pseudo-3D visuals and no external game engine.
- Online mode is a simulated lobby; progress and ghost data are stored locally in `localStorage`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game screens, setup modal, race HUD, touch controls, responsive styling, save state, store purchases, navigation, daily claim, world/reward rendering, race loop, rivals, and canvas scene.
- Added world progression on wins and keyboard handler cleanup between races.
- Added daily task claim buttons and weekly reward claiming; claims and task progress are saved locally.
- Added race countdown cleanup and a finish guard to prevent duplicate race rewards.
- Changed Pass the Bimba tagging to hand off between player and rival on a timer.

### Active
- Validate runtime/gameplay after the latest edits and review reward and event flows.
- Confirm the Bimba event’s overall 30-second duration and completion/reward behavior; current code starts its tag timer at 30 seconds but then continues switching tag ownership on shorter intervals until the race ends.

### Blocked
- Browser validation remains blocked: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` reported `Browser "chromium" is not installed`; system Chromium exists at `/usr/bin/chromium`.

## Next Move
1. Run `node --check game.js` and resolve any syntax/runtime issues from recent changes.
2. Finish reviewing daily/weekly reward behavior, including the weekly claim date logic and task-claim persistence.
3. Ensure Pass the Bimba is a 30-second event with a clear end condition and correct rewards.
4. Validate navigation, purchases, modes, controls, rewards, progression, and event flow in a browser; capture and inspect a current screenshot if browser access is available.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: game state, race mechanics, rendering, rewards.
- `index.html`: game UI and screen markup.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and game UI styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A Python development server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `node --check game.js` passed before the latest edits; it has not been rerun since.
- Daily task counters and claims reset on local-date change; daily login claim uses local date.
- Weekly reward claim currently stores `lastWeekly` as the current date and `claimedDays` as `[today]`; review whether this matches intended weekly streak semantics.
